test_name: Off-key mark and test-id coexistence — procedure model (callback chaining)
description: Procedure-model companion to off-key-coexistence.json. cnb:use-procedure-model is #t and the config procedure assigns off-key-mark 'dot to any pitch class outside the key, so the engraver's procedure-model branch (not the vector branch) chains the mark callback onto after-line-breaking. With test-ids.ly also active, the F#4 NoteHead must carry both the test-id tag and the off-key dot.

assertions.description: All 4 noteheads present and tagged by test-ids
F#4 notehead: test-id tag present (id resolves, data-* correct)
F#4 notehead: off-key dot present (bbox taller than in-key C4)
C4 (in key): no off-key mark, bbox is plain notehead height
